Home.title: Build precise gauges in your browser.
Home.description: The editor workspace is ready for its first implementation stage. Create vector-based gauge layouts locally, then save them as JSON.

Help.title: Learn the editor
Help.description: The full in-app guide will grow alongside the available layers.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.description: Create a Range or open an example to begin.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Use Layers to navigate and Properties to edit a layer.

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Ranges define the coordinate and scale context for a gauge.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Projects are versioned JSON files validated before import.

status.layerReset: Layer settings restored to their defaults.
status.rangeRequired: Create a Range before adding a visual layer.
status.rangeDependencyWarning: Large changes to this Range may automatically adjust {count, plural, one {the linked layer} other {# linked layers}}. Element sizes and visible values may be limited to fit the new Range.
status.canvasWidthTooSmall: Canvas width must be at least {minimum} mm to keep the center of “{name}” inside.
status.canvasHeightTooSmall: Canvas height must be at least {minimum} mm to keep the center of “{name}” inside.
status.canvasRadiusTooLarge: At least one canvas dimension must be {minimum} mm or greater to support the radius of “{name}”.

validation.invalidProject: The value was not applied because it would make the project invalid.
validation.invalidSchema: The entered value has an invalid format or is outside its permitted range.
validation.invalidName: The name is required and must contain no more than 80 characters.
validation.duplicateObjectId: The value was not applied because object identifiers must be unique.
validation.missingRangeReference: Select an existing Range for this layer.
validation.valueMustBePositive: The resulting value must be greater than zero.
validation.valueOutsideAllowedRange: The entered value is outside the range allowed by the related geometry.
validation.valueStartAfterEnd: The start value cannot be greater than the end value.
validation.valueRangeMustHaveSpan: The start and end values must define a non-zero interval.
validation.tooManyGeneratedItems: Increase the step so the scale generates no more than {max} items.
validation.scaleBoundsNotAscending: The scale end value must be greater than its start value.
validation.customScaleEndpointsInvalid: Custom Scale positions must begin at 0 and end at 1.
validation.customScaleNotMonotonic: Each Custom Scale value and position must be greater than the previous point.

layers.title: Layers
layers.propertiesDescription: Adjust this visual element and its source Range.

picker.title: Choose a layer type
picker.description: Select the visual element you want to add to this gauge.
picker.tickScaleDescription: Draw radial tick marks using the selected Range.
picker.numericScaleDescription: Draw value labels using the selected Range.
picker.labelDescription: Add regular labels or text that follows the selected Range path.
picker.arcDescription: Draw a styled arc between values on the selected Range.
picker.needleDescription: Point to a value using the selected Range mapping.
picker.ellipseDescription: Add a positioned, sized, and rotated ellipse.
picker.rectangleDescription: Add a rectangle with optional rounded corners.

layers.emptyDescription: Add a visual layer to start rendering your gauge.

ranges.title: Ranges
ranges.emptyDescription: Ranges define the position, radius, and value range used by visual layers.
ranges.deleteDisabled: Remove the {count, plural, one {dependent layer} other {# dependent layers}} before deleting this Range.

confirmation.deleteLayerDescription: This will permanently remove {name} from the project.
confirmation.deleteRangeDescription: This will permanently remove {name} and its value mapping from the project.
confirmation.resetLayerDescription: This will restore the visual settings of the selected layer to their defaults.

projectSettings.title: Project settings
projectSettings.description: Canvas dimensions are project data. Snapping is a local editor preference.

range.title: Range setup
range.description: Define the geometry, value mapping, and pivot context shared by visual layers.
range.scaleModeChangeDescription: Changing the mode resets all scale values to the defaults for the selected mode and may adjust linked layers.

customCurve.description: Value runs horizontally and normalized dial position vertically. Values are integers and follow the project distance increment when snapping is enabled; positions use 0.05 increments.

canvas.emptyDescription: Create your first Range to define a dial, or select one of the starter examples.

controls.name: Name
controls.pendingCommit: Press Enter or click outside to apply. Esc cancels.
controls.invalidNumber: Enter a number for {label} between {min} and {max}.
